subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should live provider model discovery become default text model catalog and picker behavior, or remain limited to explicit provider wildcards and provider-specific runtime fallbacks?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider/plugin API contracts, config semantics, model selection UX, cache/offline policy, and safety/cost controls, which source inspection cannot decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical design thread and review provider-specific implementation slices against one shared API and UX contract.

options.title: Split By Provider
options.body: Break the remaining work into OpenRouter, OpenAI-compatible, local-provider, and gateway-specific issues after one shared plugin API decision.

options.title: Limit To Wildcards
options.body: Declare configured provider wildcards the supported dynamic-discovery surface and close broader default picker/list discovery as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical design thread and review provider-specific implementation slices against one shared API and UX contract.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 is the assigned owner of this maintainer-labeled umbrella issue carrying the product decision.
